reply_text: @Bettina Kroll: the only source I can see is Moss's Coastal digest dated 2 Nov 2025, which says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." That is a forward-looking note written the day before, so 3 Nov 2025 is the planned handover date, not a confirmed one. I found no record in the Coastal files or this channel confirming that it happened on that date. For the tracker, I'd cite it as "planned 2025-11-03 per Moss's 11/2 digest, not yet confirmed." To verify the official date, ask Moss or Kwame directly, or check the account ownership record in Pemberline Dock.
